companyOverview.name: LightsOn International
companyOverview.tagline: Illuminating Global Commerce. Protecting Generational Wealth.
companyOverview.missionStatement: To build, protect, and expand a portfolio of strategically aligned businesses across global markets through disciplined ownership, trust-centered governance, and long-term value creation.
companyOverview.visionStatement: To become a premier international holding and operating structure recognized for integrity, multi-generational prosperity, and transformative impact across industries and continents.
companyOverview.shortDescription: LightsOn International is an umbrella holding and operating structure designed to own, control, and grow multiple businesses domestically and internationally — built on a foundation of trust-centered ownership and dynastic wealth preservation.
companyOverview.longDescription: LightsOn International serves as the central umbrella holding entity for a growing portfolio of business ventures across the United States and Latin America. Structured around The Light Trust, the organization is engineered for asset protection, operational control, and multi-generational wealth transfer. The portfolio spans trading, retail, short-term rentals, art and hospitality, EV transportation, and charter services — each entity built to generate compounding returns on a disciplined rollout schedule.
